info.title: terse
info.description: Token-efficient Roslyn MCP server for C# and .NET. Navigate, read, edit and refactor a solution semantically instead of reading whole files.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: TerseSharp - token-efficient Roslyn MCP server for C# and .NET.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the MCP server over stdio.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Solution or project to load at startup.

options.name: --no-watch
options.description: Do not watch the workspace for external file changes. TERSE_WATCH=0 does the same. [default: False]

options.name: --max-workspaces
options.description: How many solutions stay loaded at once; the least recently used is unloaded beyond that. Default 4. TERSE_MAX_WORKSPACES does the same. A large solution costs gigabytes, so set 1 when you only ever work in one.

commands.name: guard
commands.description: Hook entry point: reads a Claude Code PreToolUse payload on stdin and denies built-in tools on C#/.NET source.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Register TerseSharp with your MCP clients.

options.name: --client
options.description: claude-code, cursor, vscode or windsurf. Omit to detect.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Solution or project to load at startup.

options.name: --skill
options.description: Also install the agent skill that teaches which TerseSharp tool replaces which built-in. [default: False]

options.name: --guard
options.description: Also install a Claude Code PreToolUse hook that blocks Read/Grep/Edit on C#/.NET and XAML files. [default: False]

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Remove TerseSharp from your MCP clients.

options.name: --client
options.description: claude-code, cursor, vscode or windsurf. Omit to detect.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Verify SDK, MSBuild, client registration and workspace load.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Solution or project to load at startup.
